Strong cross-cultural communication skills to effectively collaborate with local finance teams and external advisors across different Asian countries.

岗位描述: 1、建立和维护与地方医保、卫生、药监等地方政府部门和利益相关者的沟通平台，确保地方层面信息获取渠道顺畅，树立良好的公司及品牌形象，通过外部沟通，在所辖区域内建立基于公司业务发展的良好内外部环境； 2. 及时掌握政策趋势，实时预判、影响政策的进展，树立风险及危机意识，推动地方政策环境的优化，配合上级在区域间积极组织、协调多元化形式的活动/合作，及时洞察行业变化，获取政策信息，积极沟通有效传递。 3、充分配合中央准入团队，积极开展与业务团队的常态化沟通，及时了解区域业务的痛点与堵点，采取前瞻性的应对举措，提供专业化针对性支持。配合部门协作形成合力，支持业务部门健康与合规地推进区域准入； 岗位交付物 1、准确研判/解读地方的相关政策，树立政策风险防范及危机管理意识，结合公司经营策略提供政策依据； 2、负责所辖区域内政府、学/协会及智库专家系统的关系维护、拓展，加强企业影响力，营造有利于公司产品推广的政策环境； 3、负责公司产品在所辖区域内准入事务的统筹管理，确保公司产品稳定的销售环境和市场秩序； 4、与区域医院、零售等业务部门紧密合作，开展月度的政策沟通与培训，推进季度的政策解读与应对方案的迭代与优化，借助危机处理机制与流程，及时应对并协调处理危机事件，助力销售达成。 5、搭建内外部沟通桥梁 ，及时传递有效信息并提出应对策略，配合上级寻找政策切入点与谈判机会点，助力区域业务的持续推进 。 能力要求 1、良好的跨团队/职能沟通能力； 2、敏锐的政策洞察力及研判能力； 4、准确理解、解读政策的能力。 5、医学、药学或相关专业本科及以上学历； 6、较强的抗压能力及情绪管理能力； 7、解决问题的能力； 8、5年以上省份/直辖市区域准入经验； 9、具备坚实的客户基础(医保、卫生、市监、学协会等)。

岗位描述: 1、建立和维护与地方医保、卫生、药监等地方政府部门和利益相关者的沟通平台，确保地方层面信息获取渠道顺畅，树立良好的公司及品牌形象，通过外部沟通，在所辖区域内建立基于公司业务发展的良好内外部环境； 2. 及时掌握政策趋势，实时预判、影响政策的进展，树立风险及危机意识，推动地方政策环境的优化，配合上级在区域间积极组织、协调多元化形式的活动/合作，及时洞察行业变化，获取政策信息，积极沟通有效传递。 3、充分配合中央准入团队，积极开展与业务团队的常态化沟通，及时了解区域业务的痛点与堵点，采取前瞻性的应对举措，提供专业化针对性支持。配合部门协作形成合力，支持业务部门健康与合规地推进区域准入； 岗位交付物 1、准确研判/解读地方的相关政策，树立政策风险防范及危机管理意识，结合公司经营策略提供政策依据； 2、负责所辖区域内政府、学/协会及智库专家系统的关系维护、拓展，加强企业影响力，营造有利于公司产品推广的政策环境； 3、负责公司产品在所辖区域内准入事务的统筹管理，确保公司产品稳定的销售环境和市场秩序； 4、与区域医院、零售等业务部门紧密合作，开展月度的政策沟通与培训，推进季度的政策解读与应对方案的迭代与优化，借助危机处理机制与流程，及时应对并协调处理危机事件，助力销售达成。 5、搭建内外部沟通桥梁 ，及时传递有效信息并提出应对策略，配合上级寻找政策切入点与谈判机会点，助力区域业务的持续推进 。 能力要求 1、良好的跨团队/职能沟通能力； 2、敏锐的政策洞察力及研判能力； 4、准确理解、解读政策的能力。 5、医学、药学或相关专业本科及以上学历； 6、较强的抗压能力及情绪管理能力； 7、解决问题的能力； 8、5年以上省份/直辖市区域准入经验； 9、具备坚实的客户基础(医保、卫生、市监、学协会等)。

岗位描述: 1、建立和维护与地方医保、卫生、药监等地方政府部门和利益相关者的沟通平台，确保地方层面信息获取渠道顺畅，树立良好的公司及品牌形象，通过外部沟通，在所辖区域内建立基于公司业务发展的良好内外部环境； 2. 及时掌握政策趋势，实时预判、影响政策的进展，树立风险及危机意识，推动地方政策环境的优化，配合上级在区域间积极组织、协调多元化形式的活动/合作，及时洞察行业变化，获取政策信息，积极沟通有效传递。 3、充分配合中央准入团队，积极开展与业务团队的常态化沟通，及时了解区域业务的痛点与堵点，采取前瞻性的应对举措，提供专业化针对性支持。配合部门协作形成合力，支持业务部门健康与合规地推进区域准入； 岗位交付物 1、准确研判/解读地方的相关政策，树立政策风险防范及危机管理意识，结合公司经营策略提供政策依据； 2、负责所辖区域内政府、学/协会及智库专家系统的关系维护、拓展，加强企业影响力，营造有利于公司产品推广的政策环境； 3、负责公司产品在所辖区域内准入事务的统筹管理，确保公司产品稳定的销售环境和市场秩序； 4、与区域医院、零售等业务部门紧密合作，开展月度的政策沟通与培训，推进季度的政策解读与应对方案的迭代与优化，借助危机处理机制与流程，及时应对并协调处理危机事件，助力销售达成。 5、搭建内外部沟通桥梁 ，及时传递有效信息并提出应对策略，配合上级寻找政策切入点与谈判机会点，助力区域业务的持续推进 。 能力要求 1、良好的跨团队/职能沟通能力； 2、敏锐的政策洞察力及研判能力； 4、准确理解、解读政策的能力。 5、医学、药学或相关专业本科及以上学历； 6、较强的抗压能力及情绪管理能力； 7、解决问题的能力； 8、5年以上省份/直辖市区域准入经验； 9、具备坚实的客户基础(医保、卫生、市监、学协会等)。

职能类别: 销售类
岗位描述: 岗位具体职责： 1.1 领导团队持续监测、收集并研读区域医保、卫健、药监等关键政策信息，预判风险与机遇，制定区域准入策略和应对方案。 1.2 负责所辖区域内政府事务、学/协会及智库专家网络的拓展与维护，搭建高效的外部沟通平台，树立良好的公司形象，影响政策环境向有利于公司的方向发展。 1.3 树立并强化团队的政策风险防范及危机管理意识，建立应对机制，快速、有效地协调处理区域内的政策相关危机事件。 1.4 推动区域“三医”平台信息化工具的应用与迭代，确保政策信息与市场洞察能够及时、准确地内部传递与应对。 2.1 领导团队制定并执行针对核心影响型医院的合作战略，确保完成医院准入、产品列名和解限控目标（衡量指标如：AA医院数量/比率、列名数量/比率、特定产品覆盖及销量）。 2.2 指导团队建立并动态更新区域关键客户档案管理系统，深度洞察客户需求，整合关键决策者反馈，并转化为业务改进建议。 2.3 亲自参与并带领团队与区域TOP医院管理层、药学专家建立并深化长期、互信的学术合作与战略伙伴关系，持续孵化创新项目。 2.4 确保团队高频次、高质量拜访关键客户，传递公司战略与产品价值，成为客户不可或缺的价值顾问。 3.1 建立定期的跨部门沟通协调机制，共享区域市场信息、政策动态及项目进展，共同制定业务推进方案。 3.2 领导团队为销售队伍提供专业的准入教练支持，包括相关工具培训、医院准入策略辅导。 3.3 整合资源，搭建跨部门项目平台，协同推动区域目标医院的产品准入、招标、RDL（医保药品目录）落地等关键事宜。 3.4 负责团队预算的制定与监控，确保客户投资计划合理且符合公司规定，实现资源投入产出最大化。 4.1 制定并实施市场准入团队的能力发展模型与培训计划，提升团队成员在政策解读、战略规划、客户关系管理等方面的综合能力。 4.2 关注人才发展，通过日常指导、绩效管理等方式识别和培养高潜力人才，建立人才梯队。 4.3 营造团队精诚合作、积极向上的氛围，激励团队完成具有挑战性的业务目标。 4.4 定期向管理层提供区域业务回顾、团队建设及市场活动总结报告。 能力职责 1、医学、药学或相关专业本科及以上学历； 2、较强的抗压能力及情绪管理能力； 3、解决问题的能力； 4、5年以上省份/直辖市区域准入经验 5、具备坚实的客户基础(医保、卫生、市监、学协会等)。 1. 良好的跨团队/职能沟通能力； 2. 敏锐的政策洞察力及研读能力 3. 团队管理能力

岗位描述: Typical Accountabilities - Manage the triage, evaluation, and follow-up of safety documents and clinical or post marketed adverse event information, ensuring accuracy, validity, and compliance with regulations. - Apply scientific and technical expertise in patient safety, supporting assessments, research, and regulatory reporting, while serving as a knowledge resource and offering statistical consultancy within the department and across teams. - Lead and mentor the local patient safety team by monitoring performance, hold direct line management responsibility, set individual objectives, conduct performance management, support career development, encourage professional development, assist with succession planning, and delegate of responsibilities and projects. - Collaborate with external organizations, regulatory authorities, and cross-functional internal teams to ensure the alignment, quality, and integrity of patient safety processes, data, and submissions. - Develop and support functional, regional, or country-level patient safety strategies, driving continuous improvement initiatives to meet organizational objectives, enhance efficiency, and optimize project outcomes. - Represent AstraZeneca’s Patient Safety function externally, networks with industry peers, and promote a culture of courageous leadership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Qualifications and Skills Essential: Bachelor’s degree in science or healthcare-related field (or equivalent patient safety experience); advanced degree preferred; extensive experience in patient safety within pharmaceutical, hospital, clinical research, or healthcare settings (including roles as a Specialist within AstraZeneca Patient Safety); thorough knowledge of patient safety processes, local regulations, and international standards (e.g., FDA and ICH regulations for patient safety and adverse event reporting); broad competence with medical, therapeutic, and technical terminology; demonstrated leadership with the ability to motivate, empower, and guide teams to achieve objectives, including cross-functional team leadership; proven ability to manage priorities, resources, performance targets, and project initiatives in global and regional environments; excellent written and verbal communication skills, along with negotiation, collaboration, and interpersonal leadership abilities; proactive in identifying patient safety issues, implementing solutions, and fostering partnerships with internal and external stakeholders; experience in budgetary and resource management planning; willingness to travel domestically and internationally. The build pairs AI-driven design with physical automation to accelerate candidate drug (CD) delivery and positioning AZ China R&D as an automation innovation hub, collaborating with fastest-moving automation partners in China. About the Role This role is the strategic and operational backbone of the Beijing Discovery Center. You sit alongside the cross-functional leadership team as a trusted thought partner and execution engine — making the build move faster through cleaner decisions, disciplined budget and milestone tracking, and clearer communication to sponsors and governance forums. Think of this as a Chief of Staff role for a capital build, with strategic thinking built in — not a traditional PMO function, but a force multiplier that turns an ambiguous, multi-workstream build into a single coherent narrative and tracker for leadership. At the start, the emphasis is operational: standing up the build's governance cadence, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, and vendor management processes so that milestone decisions do not depend on ad hoc coordination. As the build matures, the role is expected to take on more forward-looking work — shaping vendor and ecosystem partnership strategy alongside BD and Alliance Management. You will lead by doing — building the trackers, running the cadence, and personally chasing down blockers across physical automation, data automation, and engineering & facilities. You will be most visible when problems are ambiguous, cross-functional, or time-sensitive (a slipping trigger date, a budget variance, a stalled vendor decision), and you will personally drive resolution rather than escalate by default. You will also prepare the analytical foundations, frame options, and drive key decisions (e.g., site selection, partnerships, CAPEX allocation) to a clear resolution. 岗位描述: INTRODUCTORY PARAGRAPH At Evinova, we put patients first and strive to meet their unmet needs worldwide. Working here means being entrepreneurial, thinking big, and working together to make the impossible a reality. If you are swift to action, confident to lead, willing to collaborate, and curious about what science can do, then you’re our kind of person. Evinova is a health-tech business, separate company within the AstraZeneca Group, accelerating the delivery of better health outcomes by propelling the life sciences sector forward in digital health, from the inside. Through our application of science-based expertise, evidence-led rigor, and human experience-driven insight, our digital solutions are deliberately crafted so that everyone can reach better health outcomes together. In this role on our Solution Delivery team, you’ll lead the design and deployment of Evinova’s platform for clinical trials. Your expertise will shape the future of clinical studies, making healthcare more efficient and accessible. 岗位描述: The Role Join AstraZeneca’s Oncology R&D in our Beijing R&D Center as a Machine Learning and AI Specialist and help shape the future of drug discovery. At AstraZeneca, we are building a variety of AI powered tools to accelerate the drug discovery process. In this role you will be responsible for implementing AI architectures for prediction of properties and 3D structures of small and large molecules complexes. Together with your colleagues you will create enhanced data sets for retraining and focusing these methods for specific use cases. You will benchmark different methods and build optimal pipelines for delivering accurate and impactful predictions. You will operate in a collaborative environment with other specialists in China and globally within R&D, and you’ll be encouraged to publish and present your work at leading conferences. Expectations of a Successful Candidate You will: Design, build and scale machine learning models (e.g., transformers, diffusion models, graph-based generative models) for molecular and biological property and structure prediction, leveraging large-scale molecular simulation, structural, affinity and potency data. Build scalable workflows : Create and maintain distributed computing pipelines on cloud/cluster environments (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, DeepSpeed, Horovod, MPI, Nvidia Apex/AMP) and work with containerisation (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration. Own protein co-folding and prediction workflows : Lead the implementation, benchmarking and optimisation of protein-ligand and protein-protein complex prediction. Define metrics, analyse results and drive decisions on algorithmic direction. Champion innovation and best practice : Evaluate emerging computational methodologies and AI technologies; relevant to the role. Benchmark and optimise these methods to define best practise. Communicate and influence : Present complex results clearly to multidisciplinary audiences, guide experimental plans, and contribute to project strategy. Publish externally : In high-quality journals and present at national and international conferences. Required Skills and Qualifications Education : PhD (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Computational Chemistry, Cheminformatics, Bioinformatics, Structural Biology or a closely related discipline. Core expertise : Strong track record with machine learning and AI methods. Experience of a range of machine/deep learning algorithms and architectures (e.g. graph neural networks, transformers). AI application : Demonstrated interest and significant practical experience building and applying generative AI/ML methods (transformers, diffusion models, flow matching). Programming and workflows : Expert level proficiency with Python and libraries for ML (e.g. PyTorch, DeepChem, Tensorflow), modern optimisation techniques and experience with pipelining tools. Ways of working : Excellent communication, presentation, teamwork, influencing, and time management skills. Desirable Skills and Qualifications Experience with Protein Structure Prediction: Use of published tools to predict structure, including protein-ligand complexes; retraining and fine-tuning of models onto specific prediction tasks. Large scale computing : experience with large-scale cloud computing, GPU acceleration and parallelisation Publications : Peer-reviewed publications in machine learning. About AstraZeneca AstraZeneca is a global, science-led biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming patients’ lives through innovative medicines. In Oncology R&D, we combine deep biological insight with state-of-the-art AI to accelerate molecular design and decision-making. Our teams operate in an open, collaborative environment across Beijing (China), Cambridge (UK) and Boston (USA), sharing best practice and pushing the boundaries of computational chemistry and machine learning. The role creates a compelling program vision and drives business value. This role oversees program vision and execution, while promoting collaboration, innovation, and ongoing improvement across cross-functional delivery teams. Strong program-centric mindset with experience managing the program lifecycle (e.g., Concept to DevOps, backlog prioritization, KPI analysis). Background in manufacturing, supply chain, and/or quality domains (GxP, MES, etc.). Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills, with experience engaging C-level executives. Strong vendor management capabilities. Strategic & Analytical Thinking: Ability to use data and user feedback to make decisions. User Empathy: A customer-centric mindset. 岗位描述: At Evinova, we put patients first and strive to meet their unmet needs worldwide. Working here means being entrepreneurial, thinking big, and working together to make the impossible a reality. If you are swift to action, confident to lead, willing to collaborate, and curious about what science can do, then you’re our kind of person. Evinova is a health-tech business, separate company within the AstraZeneca Group, accelerating the delivery of better health outcomes by propelling the life sciences sector forward in digital health, from the inside. Through our application of science-based expertise, evidence-led rigor, and human experience-driven insight, our digital solutions are deliberately crafted so that everyone can reach better health outcomes together. The Director, AI Solution Consulting is a strategic role responsible for leading AI solution pre-sales and AI consulting service in the China market. Based in Shanghai or Beijing , this individual will work closely with commercial, digital health, product, delivery, and global teams to shape differentiated AI-enabled solutions for pharmaceutical and biotech customers across R&D clinical research. The role requires a combination of strong AI technical depth, consulting credibility, and customer engagement capability — turning complex business problems into practical, scalable, and high-value AI solutions. WHAT THE ROLE INVOLVES Key Responsibilities: Lead AI solution consulting and pre-sales activities for strategic opportunities across the China market. Partner with commercial teams to shape opportunities, qualify customer needs, and develop compelling AI solution strategies and proposals. Act as a trusted advisor to customers, translating business challenges in clinical development into practical AI-enabled solutions. Lead customer discovery sessions, solution workshops, executive presentations, and technical discussions. Lead the preparation and delivery of compelling product demonstrations tailored to clients' specific needs, effectively showcasing the benefits and features of Evinova AI solutions. Manage the creation and upkeep of demo environments to ensure they are up-to-date and aligned with client needs. Design end-to-end AI solution concepts, covering use cases, data and workflow requirements, model approach, integration, deployment, and governance considerations. Provide subject matter expertise in modern AI technologies, including LLMs, ML, prompt engineering, RAG, agentic workflows, model evaluation, and AI engineering. Partner with product management and engineering teams to ensure smooth product releases and alignment with client expectations and requirements. Work closely with product, engineering, AI/data science, delivery, and compliance teams to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned with platform strategy. Support development of proposals, statements of work, business cases, and executive-level presentation materials. Advise customers on enterprise AI adoption and transformation, including readiness, prioritisation, deployment options, responsible AI, and risk management. Stay current on market trends, competitive developments, and emerging AI innovation to strengthen Evinova’s positioning in China. Represent the company at industry events and conferences, engaging with potential clients and collaborators to promote Evinova AI solutions. SKILLS AND CAPABILITIES NEEDED Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, or a related field; advanced degree preferred. 8+ years of relevant experience in AI technology, solution consulting, pre-sales, enterprise architecture, or digital transformation. Strong technical depth in LLMs, ML, transformer architecture, model training/fine-tuning, agentic AI engineering, solution architecture, and enterprise AI deployment. Proven experience in AI solution pre-sales, consulting and solution design, with a strong track record of customer-facing engagement. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for senior business and technical stakeholders. Good understanding of clinical development workflows, trial operations, and digital clinical systems is highly desirable. Strong executive presence and ability to work effectively across a local and global matrix organisation. Strong consulting, problem-solving, and structured communication skills. Well-developed senior stakeholder management skill with proven problem-solving, collaboration and interpersonal leadership skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to deal with ambiguity and create clarity. Fluent English and Mandarin, both of which must be usable as working languages. Willingness and ability to travel up to 30%, including both domestic and international travels. AI-first Mentality, result-driven and ’Can-do’ attitude. Experience in life sciences, pharmaceutical R&D, clinical research, healthcare technology, or other regulated industries is strongly preferred. Deep knowledge of ICH E6 R3 Good Clinical Practice, FDA 21 CFR part 11, EU GDPR, EU AI Act and China Generative AI Measures is highly preferred. Hands-on experience implementing or governing CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM) and USDM (Unified Study Definitions Model) in clinical data management or regulatory submission workflows is highly preferred. MBA is preferred coupled with prior experience implementing leading life sciences software products. Why Evinova (AstraZeneca)? Evinova draws on AstraZeneca’s deep experience developing novel therapeutics, informed by insights from thousands of patients and clinical researchers. Together, we can accelerate the delivery of life-changing medicines, improve the design and delivery of clinical trials for better patient experiences and outcomes, and think more holistically about patient care before, during, and after treatment. We know that regulators, healthcare professionals, and care teams at clinical trial sites do not want a fragmented approach. They do not want a future where every pharmaceutical company provides its own, different digital solutions. They want solutions that work across the sector, simplify their workload, and benefit patients broadly. By bringing our solutions to the wider healthcare community, we can help build more unified approaches to how we all develop and deploy digital technologies, better serving our teams, physicians, and ultimately patients. Evinova represents a unique opportunity to deliver meaningful outcomes with digital and AI to serve the wider healthcare community and create new standards for the sector. Join us on our journey of building a new kind of health tech business to reset expectations of what a bio-pharmaceutical company can be. This means we’re opening new ways to work, pioneering cutting-edge methods, and bringing unexpected teams together. Interested? Come and join our journey. So, what’s next? Description of Job Responsibilities; Typical and Specific accountabilities: Responsible expert for the delivery of PAT (instrument, chemometrics, and process control) support for on-market commercial products. Responsible for the framework lifecycle management of chemometric models related to the commercial supply or testing of drug products, ensuring equivalency for multi-site models. Management of products knowledge throughout the product lifecycle to enable robust PAT/model use and control strategies. Provides support for model updates and validation in the on-market space. Responsible for the support of impact or transfer of PAT methods (including chemometric model) in relation to asset strategy projects to AZ or external manufacturing partners. Takes leadership in developing, maintaining, and collaborating with instrument vendors (including software) and model software vendors to support changes, improvements and issue resolution. Defines business strategy for the integration of PAT/MSPC in the on-market space. Leads stakeholder engagement and builds business cases for implementation of new PAT technologies in the on-market space. Leads, assesses impact & supports complex technical improvements or change activities assuring product performance. Knowledgeable of vibrational spectroscopy methods and Process Analytical Technology (PAT) applications and provides support to associated models during development and routine use phases. Supports the development of models used in the application of improving product robustness – including process performance monitoring, process performance predictive modelling, real-time or near real time models, etc. via methods such as MSPC (multivariate statistical process control). Identifies opportunities for model improvements and digital innovation. Using domain-specific understanding, translates unstructured, complex business problems into the appropriate data problem, model and analytical solutions. Researches and develops advanced predictive models and computational methods to guide and shape decision-making within the project scope. Essential Skills/Experience: Ph.D. – 5+ years, MS – 8+ years, BS – 10+ years of relevant industry experience. 岗位描述: *Please submit your resume in English. About the Beijing AI Center The Beijing AI Center is a new strategic investment by AstraZeneca to accelerate drug discovery through AI. The center brings together AI researchers, computational scientists, and platform engineers to apply foundation models, agentic AI, and large-scale scientific computing to real R&D problems. Situated in one of the world’s most dynamic AI talent markets, it operates at the intersection of AI and biologics discovery, computational chemistry, and data-driven drug development. About the Role Help build AstraZeneca's Beijing AI Center from the ground up, and own how AI gets done there. This is the person who turns a new on-premises GPU cluster, a fast-growing team, and China's foundation-model ecosystem into platform capabilities that make drug-discovery science faster. You set the methods, standards, and tooling that sit between raw infrastructure and the scientists using it. Success is the adoption, scale, and reuse of those capabilities across Discovery teams, not the delivery of any single AI project. The center runs on three teams that depend on each other: Discovery verticals (biologics engineering, computational chemistry) own the science; Data & AI Platforms - this role - owns the capabilities; and R&D IT owns the infrastructure. A dedicated on-premises GPU cluster provides the compute backbone, operated by IT and shaped by your standards. As Enterprise AI's single point of accountability for the center, you are who global and local stakeholders come to when a capability needs standing up, a bottleneck removed, or an ad hoc problem solved. You lead through your team and through the product owners you direct rather than building everything yourself; what you bring personally is enough technical depth to set the bar and judge the work. You own the requirements, methods, tooling, and evaluation rigor that make Discovery and IT more productive. IT handles GPU provisioning, cluster operations, and networking; Discovery owns model architecture, training objectives, and scientific interpretation. You own the requirements, forecasting, MLOps standards, and the engineering approach that makes it productive for research. 3. Agentic AI Platform - Direction & Delivery Set the direction for the center's agentic AI platform and deliver it through a product owner and their team. Set the vision and roadmap: multi-agent orchestration, local agent development frameworks, and scientific workflow automation Direct delivery through a product owner and team - setting outcomes, holding delivery to account, and unblocking, rather than building it personally Deliver against measured impact: adoption, developer productivity, scientific enablement, and business value Judge what to build, buy, or partner for: evaluate the China LLM landscape (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Moonshot) and assess local partnerships (e.g., Alibaba, Tencent, Baidu) for inference, agent hosting, and platform capabilities Set the methodology for evaluating agent reliability, safety, and scientific accuracy, and define - with the product owner and IT - who owns runtime guardrails and tool-use permissioning once agents touch sensitive systems Boundary: IT provides hosting infrastructure; a product owner runs the hands-on build. You own the direction - what gets built and why, which LLMs and partners are selected, and how impact is measured. 4. AI Engineering - Standards, Evaluation & Depth Set the center's AI engineering bar: the methods, standards, and evaluation frameworks that make the work reproducible and comparable. As External Manufacturing Procurement Director for New Modalities, you will be a core member of the leadership team, guiding category strategy and supplier partnerships that accelerate our pipeline from clinical to commercial supply. This role puts you at the heart of portfolio-level sourcing and commercial governance for critical platforms, from new technologies to scale-up solutions. Could you be the commercial leader who turns complex portfolios into coherent supply strategies that deliver speed, quality, and sustainable value? You will partner across functions to resolve issues quickly, embed focused ways of working, and demonstrate measurable financial outcomes that move the business forward. Accountabilities: Category Leadership and Representation: Serve as a core member of the External Manufacturing Leadership Team, representing your category to shape decisions and set direction. Strategy Deployment and Governance: Partner with the leadership team to develop and deploy the external manufacturing strategy, refreshed governance model, and business process framework; ensure these are embedded across the category and supplier base to enable consistent delivery. End-to-End Category Ownership: Hold end-to-end accountability for category technology across clinical and commercial supply, including strategic roadmap, sourcing, contracting, and issue concerns to safeguard continuity and performance. Portfolio Sourcing for New Modalities: Lead portfolio-level sourcing within the category (e.g. new modalities/technologies, scale-up platforms); conduct market analysis, due diligence, risk assessment, negotiations, and MSA implementation to secure capacity, capability, and value. Commercial Relationship Governance: Provide commercial leadership to key strategic relationships; own commercial relationship governance and inputs into BRMs; drive joint innovation, productivity, and resilience initiatives that strengthen our supply network. Cross-Functional Alignment: Align category strategy and sourcing decisions with business needs; act as a trusted partner to ESM, GSC&S, PT&D/BPD, Quality, Finance, and Technical functions; facilitate cross-functional decision-making and issue resolution to balance risk, cost, and speed. Complex Program Delivery and Value: Lead and deliver complex, high-impact projects; demonstrate financial outcomes and broader benefits that support growth and patient impact. Performance and Scorecard Management: Own delivery of scorecard objectives, track performance, and take corrective actions to meet commitments, ensuring transparency and accountability. Process ownership and Compliance: Take ownership of selected procurement and business processes. Invent and put into practice the operational process structure and follow established ways of working for operational excellence. Procurement Excellence and Enablement: Demonstrate and advance the Procurement 222 strategy in daily operations; foster adoption of tools, data, and governance; coach teams on standard process to elevate capability across the network. Complex Agreement Negotiation: Lead negotiations for large, complex agreements; structure and implement MSAs, supply agreements, and performance frameworks that underpin long-term success. Market Intelligence and Innovation: Lead market analysis, cost/price benchmarking, and risk/opportunity scanning; provide strategic insights on capacity, technology trends, and competitive dynamics; incubate innovation with suppliers to future-proof the category. Executive Representation and Decision Support: Act as the procurement lead on relevant boards, global supply teams, and business review meetings; prepare materials and present recommendations; ensure decisions are documented and driven with rigour. Constructive Challenge and Accountability: Be a constructive challenger with gravitas; hold teams and suppliers to account while maintaining strong partnerships that deliver results. ﻿Essential Skills/Experience: Significant experience in commercial/procurement roles, with significant time in API related categories and/or complex, regulated environments. Proven ability to design category strategies and deploy multiyear improvement plans; track record of delivering measurable financial and operational value. Demonstrated success negotiating large, complex contracts. Strong communication and ability to influence senior stakeholders Hands on leadership and coaching experience Experience leading commercial supplier relationships and governance; drives performance, innovation, and resilience agendas. Experience owning or designing procurement/business processes; able to standardise and embed ways of working. Strong financial literacy, cost modelling, benchmarking, and data-driven decision-making. 岗位描述: 责任描述和工作范围 参与QC细胞组日常检验及管理工作，包括工作安排及跟踪、文件体系建立等，及时高效地完成组内检验任务，并确 保检验活动符合国内外法律法规及公司内部质量要求。主要工作如下： 细胞组检验 参与细胞组实验室区域正常的日常管理并确保正常运行，协助QC实验室质量体系的持续改进提高； 参与QC细胞组相关分析方法接收、方法确认、检验方法标准操作规程及记录起草； 组织QC细胞组分析方法验证实施及验证报告撰写，保证分析方法的有效性； 主导QC细胞组复杂仪器设备标准操作规程及记录起草，并参与文件的审核； 按计划组织人员对物料、慢病毒载体及CAR-T等样本的放行检验及质量研究检验，保证检验数据的真实性和 可靠性，并组织检验过程中参数的整理收集； 参与制定QC细胞组相关中间品与成品的稳定性研究方案起草，并组织人员按照方案完成稳定性研究实施； 参与对QC细胞组配制试剂、检测细胞库、质控品等按照相关规定进行管理。任职资格。 任职要求 本科及以上学历，药学、生物学、基础医学、检验医学等相关专业，3年以上生物制药行业QC经验，至少2年以上GMP环境下工作经验，具备细胞治疗相关经验者优先； 英语六级及以上，听说读写能力佳，可英文写作如起草英文SOP、方案、调查报告等； 具备细胞培养相关的理论知识，熟练掌握贴壁细胞和悬浮细胞培养的基本操作，具备T细胞、HeLa细胞系培养经验优先； 具备流式分析相关的理论知识，熟练掌握流式分析相关的基本操作及BD流式细胞仪的使用，具备BD Canto或Lyric流式细胞仪使用经验优先； 具备CAR-T细胞培养、效能及流式相关检验经验优先； 具备分析方法验证操作及验证报告撰写经验优先； 具备对检验结果进行趋势分析，独立处理OOS、偏差等质量事件经验优先； 需适应细胞治疗行业快节奏及低容错率，本岗位涉及的检验工作容错率较低，需要具备较强的抗压能力，并需要适应轮班或加班，胜任高强度快节奏的检验任务。 $(function () { var recommendBtn = ' 推 荐 '; var applyBtn = ' 申请 '; var appliedBtn = ' 已申请 '; var volApplyBtn = ' 选好了，去投递简历 '; var addVolBtn = ' 添加到志愿 '; var collectBtn = ' 收藏 '; var collectedBtn = ' 已收藏 '; var goPositionListBtn = ' 返回列表 '; var isApplication = "false"; var isCollection = "false"; var content = ' '; var staffNotApply = ""; var currentPositionInRemoveVols = ""; if(true){ content += getApplyStr() } else { if(false){ var tips = " 您已认证为员工身份，请勿投递！ "; staffNotApply = tips } } if (false) { content += recommendBtn; if(true){ content += ' '; } } content += " "; if (isCollection === "false") { content += collectBtn } else { content += collectedBtn } if( false){ if ("false" === "true" && ("false" === "false" || "" === "true")) { $("#positionDetail").append(' '); } } $("#positionDetail").append('

岗位名称: Senior Director –  Site IT APAC Region
岗位描述: The purpose of the APAC role is to lead a regional team of skilled & specialist IT Professionals who will manage, deliver and actively drive improvements for the IT infrastructure, tools and services that directly support the workforce across their sites. The role will have an in-depth understanding of ETS technologies and services as well as the delivery organisations and their operations. In liaison with technical/service capability owners/ETS LT members they will understand the technical landscape of the region ensuring its current and future performance will meet business need and is fully documented. They will understand the workforce requirements across the region at a persona/BTG level to enable effective delivery of world-class services including a thorough appreciation of the impact from IT on business-critical activities for their region, including CMDB data, ensuring this is all documented and understood. They will represent ETS (for demand and supply) via a network of site/regional stakeholders including BTG and/or Site IT Lead and Site Leadership Teams. They will have accountability for consistency and delivery of AskIT, Onsite & VIP services across their region, they will also have accountability for delivery of OCS Services; all aligning to the overall Operations IT & Onsite service strategies and SOPs. They will be accountable across the region for the proactive engagement and adoption of technologies by the workforce via effective communication and training in liaison with Service Owners or providers. They will own and run any other locally sourced or specific services for the region and manage contracts tightly. They will ensure local IT teams in Marketing Companies are fully informed and engaged to support a globally consistent approach to services. This APAC role will also play a key part in leadership and collaboration across the entire ETS organisation based in China on behalf of the ETS Leadership Team. Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities Service Delivery, Performance & Exploitation: A ccountable for the highest levels of user experience and satisfaction for all services delivered into a region including new service introductions which should have engaged with ATS processes. Work with required teams and Service Improvement Lead on Regional/Site SIPs as required to increase satisfaction and Pulse scores. Accountable for proactively managing expectations and enabling colleagues to exploit our services at a regional level, through communication, education and awareness, referral to specific services that underpin delivery including Service Levels and leveraging of effective core IT processes. Accountable for service performance levels attainment of owned services at the regional level, utilising standardised dashboards and visual performance management techniques to see daily, weekly and monthly service attainment, risks and issues and linkage to service improvement plans. Accountable for driving service standards, engagement with global processes and ensuring local infrastructure is lifecycle managed in liaison with all marketing companies within the region. Ensure a high level of knowledge of key ITSM toolset and processes, performance measurement platforms and reporting capabilities to ensure they are understood, utilised and support daily run of service across the region. Acts as a key escalation point for high-priority service issues relevant to the region and support the resolution of issues working with the Command Centre, Owners and business aligned BTGs. Accountable for the delivery of OCS specialist services working directly with the Direct Channels Lead for strategy on technology and equipment. Daily run of OCS services to a set of global standards and operating procedures ensuring the service delivered is globally consistent. Accountable for the delivery of AskIT, Onsite & VIP services as OneIT with the Service Experience strategy owner and aligned to global strategy, a set of global standards and operating procedures ensuring the services delivered across the region are globally consistent. O versee/direct lifecycle management of local infrastructure working closely relevant ETS Tower on the currency of servers in the region to ensure resilience and minimise business risk. Support the delivery of asset build/provision services in the region working directly with Direct Channels Lead for relationship with any service delivery partner. Support project planning and delivery for regional impact and change. Assist with requirements gathering, impact assessment, project planning and ultimate delivery into a site and location. Support project delivery of any regional footprint changes, including site expansions or reductions and put demand into delivery organisation. Ensure IT is carried out in a compliant manner in the region, including asset management, SOx, GxP and IT security, internal and external assurance activities are executed, and outputs actioned. Implement global/direct controls and influencing non-IT personnel appropriately. Partner with IT Quality Management & IT Security experts to ensure input of specialist knowledge for compliance aligned with regulatory requirements, customer expectations and IT strategy. Champion the use of ETS technology and service catalogue adoption amongst regions/business to avoid duplicate or parallel technologies/services introduced locally. Service Innovation: Ensure identification of opportunities to automate, consolidate or rationalise IT service delivery across the region is scoped and in agreement with service owners. Support the Remote Channels Lead to ensure IT Remote Service Channels are developed, promoted, adopted and content is enriched for local use in local language in the region. Work with broad IT community to have a detailed understanding of regional roadmap activities and service innovations/new features to support deployment in the region. Ensure we identify opportunities to bring non ETS supported Infrastructure & devices to global ETS standards & support scope, e.g. backups, servers, DB’s, networks, end user devices etc. Accountable for driving a culture of self-service and use of global workflows to drive further efficiencies across the region. Leadership & Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure our technologies, services and the way we deliver them meet customer needs now and in the future. Represent the ETS Leadership Team on Regional Leadership Teams as required, including BTGs LT alignment where nominated. Govern technology partners effectively where local agreements exist to ensure AZ is getting world-class levels of service, benefiting from innovation and continuously improving delivery. Build and lead a strong regional technical team focused on colleague centricity and relationship management, with focus on attention to detail, ‘right from me’ attitude and takes end-to-end ownership. Ensure the team can work directly with capability leads, convey technical into business process. Continuous learning and training approach. Be a key member of Global IT Service & Experience Leadership Team to ensure that the team has key input to overall service strategy, including Service Review Board participation. Conversely ensuring the depth and breadth of the GS&E team responsibilities is understood by all roles in Site Technical Teams and they know who to go to for help. Manage regional budget and feedback information to IT Financial Management process. Function / Team / Location The Regional IT Technical Director will be a member of the Global IT Service & Experience Leadership Team and reports to the Global Head of IT Service & Experience. 6-8 direct reports and regional team of 60+ but may also manage through matrix management structure in ETS. Regions are Americas (including LATAM) or EMEA or APAC Essential Skills & Experience required: A passion for delivering world-class service continually challenging in pursuit of the user experience and striving for improvement performance. Fluent in English written and spoken, second language beneficial but not essential. Significant experience in the Bio/Pharma or Retail industry for service Strategic thinker, with innovative ideas and solutions for service delivery and exploitation Strong technical understanding across a range of technologies/domains. Superb communication and engagement skills and a proven relationship management professional Strong stakeholder skills to manage regional negotiations, expectations and resolutions. Strong influencing, networking and team working skills Strong experience working in a standards/governed/compliant environment Proven track record of owning and delivery IT Services in large organisation. Excellent knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM Toolset or similar. Proven experience owning, managing vendors, contracts, renewals, RFP activities. Leader and team player – sets example for team leads, line managers and others to follow. Knowledge of databases, particularly Oracle or HANA. 5. Familiarity with SAP Solution Manager; experience with ChaRM usage and configuration is preferred. 6. Understanding of SAP system upgrades; experience with SAP system upgrades or S/4HANA upgrades is preferred. 7. Strong teamwork skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple resources to ensure successful project implementation. 8. Strong learning ability and adaptability to quickly adopt new technologies and environments. 9. Basic understanding of AI applications in DevOps; experience with AI tools such as Codex and Claude Code is preferred.

岗位描述: 主要职责 推动 AIGC 端到端落地与生产级交付 围绕业务场景，负责 AIGC 解决方案从需求理解、原型验证、方案设计到生产交付的全过程，推动商业价值实现。 开发可复用的 AIGC 工作流与智能体能力 基于 LangChain、Dify、N8N 等开源框架，构建可插拔、可复用的 AIGC 工作流解决方案；开发具备 harness 约束的智能体框架，支持业务流程重塑。 优化智能体方案并提升业务适配性 结合具体业务场景和业务逻辑，持续迭代智能体方案，在自主性、指令遵循、结果准确性和可控性之间取得最佳平衡。 建设 AI Readiness 与数据基础能力 理解 AI Readiness 的基本概念，协助梳理业务数据、知识资产和流程信息，为智能体和工作流开发提供可靠的数据基础。 快速交付原型及配套前后端方案 熟练使用 AI 工具，遵循“原型先行、快速验证”的交付理念，完成智能体方案及其配套前后端能力的设计与展示。 提供数据可视化与业务洞察服务 面向业务部门提供数据可视化解决方案，利用 BI 报表和分析工具呈现数据洞察，体现业务数据价值。 负责模型与智能体工程化落地 具备模型服务、智能体框架、工作流编排和系统集成的工程化能力，支持 AIGC/LLM 功能稳定上线。 开展知识共享与团队赋能 定期进行技术分享、最佳实践沉淀和案例复盘，提升团队在 AIGC、LLM、Agentic AI 方向的整体能力。 验证前沿技术在业务场景中的可行性 与团队成员和业务利益相关方协作，评估并验证新技术在实际业务场景中的技术可行性和落地价值。 协同完成 AIGC/LLM 功能交付 与 DevOps、平台、数据及业务团队合作，完成 AIGC/LLM 相关能力的部署、集成、运维和持续优化。 完成团队负责人安排的其他相关工作 任职要求 计算机科学、数据科学、人工智能或相关专业硕士及以上学历。 具备工业级 AIGC/LLM 项目开发经验，有从原型验证到生产交付的完整实践经验。 具备扎实的 AIGC/LLM 理论基础，能够根据业务问题选择合适的算法、模型和技术方案。 具备云原生环境下 LLM 模型部署、服务化和工程化交付能力。 熟悉传统人工智能、机器学习和深度学习方法，理解常见深度学习模型及其应用场景。 精通 Python，熟悉常用数据分析、AI/ML 及 LLM 开发相关库和工具。 熟悉主流 LLM 应用框架和平台，如 FastGPT、RagFlow、Dify、LangChain 等，能够优化工作流编排以满足工业化交付要求。 理解主流大模型的基本原理和训练方法，如 LLaMA、Qwen、LoRA 微调、RLHF 等。 能够设计并实现面向大模型请求的高性能、高可用后端服务，保障低延迟、高吞吐和稳定的数据处理能力。 熟悉 Agentic AI 相关技术，包括智能体编排、工具调用、工作流设计及基于 LangChain 等框架的开发实践。 对创新和新技术保持热情，具备较强的主动学习能力和技术探索精神。 具备良好的中英文沟通能力，能够进行清晰的口头和书面表达。 具备 AWS 云上开发经验、大数据开发经验，或熟悉 Terraform 等基础设施即代码工具者优先。 具备 BI 报表开发和业务数据分析经验，熟悉 Tableau、Power BI 等 BI 工具者优先。

岗位描述: Job Summary: This product focused position performs established technical tasks at the sub-system and/or component level for current and future products within a given business unit or corporate area. This involves work across many steps in the product life cycle. Because of the product centered nature of this position, they are very often a central point of coordination and decision making between product line engineers, customer teams, systems engineers, purchasing, suppliers and manufacturing. Key Responsibilities: Obtains input from stakeholders such as technical managers, project leaders, other product and manufacturing engineers and supplier partners to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Applies academic knowledge and existing experience to take action and make decisions that progress projects forward without sacrificing project quality expectations. Examples of these decisions include day to day project details, analysis or test work instruction details, coordination across discipline areas that are necessary to make quality progress. Applies and improves processes such as Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) and tools such as 7-step problem solving, design review checklist and other specialized tools required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, industry-standard testing practices, and bug tracking tools.

岗位描述: 项目介绍： “礼想储备生-医药推广” 是礼来为未来医药人才打造的优才储备项目。 你将先加入礼来， 完成不少于3个月的实习 ，在真实业务场景中学习专业知识、积累实战经验，在资深经理的指导下完成从校园到职场的成长跃迁。 毕业前，我们将综合评估实习表现及专业能力，表现优秀的同学将收获全职Offer，正式加入礼来。 从医药推广出发，但未来不止于此。无论是专业深耕、团队管理，还是更多跨领域发展机会，都在等你解锁~ 项目亮点： 双导师带教： 资深经理+带教伙伴全程陪伴，从专业学习到职场适应，带你快速了解医药行业，融入团队 长期发展规划： 从新人起步到专业进阶，为你搭建清晰的发展路径，帮助你一步步拓宽职业发展的可能性 高转正率： 高于行业的转正率，优秀储备生有机会获得全职Offer，让实习更有目标感 你的职责： 专业知识学习：掌握包括但不限于礼来公司和医药行业相关信息、基础产品和合规知识、学术推广技巧等内容 推广技能提升：跟随地区经理和带教师傅建立与区域客户的有效沟通，通过专业的学术推广向客户提供解决方案，在实习期间不设有业务指标 跨部门合作：协调内外跨团队资源，参与区域市场项目的执行与实施 基本要求: 全日制本科或以上学历的2027年应届毕业生，符合《医药代表管理办法》（包括其不时修订的更新版本）要求的医学、药学或相关专业 具备出色的 沟通能力 和 学习能力 ，具备积 极主动 的心态和勇于挑战的 韧性 优先考虑有医药行业相关实习或有在高校组织担任干事经验的学生 确保能够实习至少3个月 招聘流程： 9-10月：简历初筛 & HR面试 10-11月：业务面试 11-12月：Offer 招聘地点： 北京

学历要求: (Training, Education & Prior Experience) Education Required: M.D., Ph.D., D.V.M., M.S., and/or PharmD or equivalent
岗位描述: Clinical Trials Co-chairs clinical study team and works collaboratively with other study team members. Point of accountability to the BU for design, conduct, interpretation and reporting of one or more clinical studies (or elements of those studies). Provides clinical and scientific expertise to the clinical trial strategy and protocol development process, including acquisition of knowledge of competitor products. Through application of Enhanced Clinical Trial Design (ECTD) / Enhanced Quantitative Drug Development (EQDD), ensures the most efficient clinical protocols are developed. Designs/writes clinical trial outlines, protocols and amendments, in collaboration with internal contributors (e.g. statisticians, Outcomes Research (OR) specialists, clinical pharmacologists, clinical project managers, Regional Clinical Site Leads (RCSLs), market access colleagues, commercial development colleagues), internal experts (e.g. clinical program lead, global clinical lead, global clinical strategy lead), and external experts (e.g. investigators, key opinion leaders, advisory board members); ensures design is consistent with objectives. Proactively authors efficient protocols that minimize the likelihood of amendments. Identifies and assesses study risks to Good Clinical Practices, subject rights/safety and data integrity throughout protocol development and study conduct; creates, implements and assesses effectiveness of mitigation plans. Provides clinical input to the Study Team for monitoring guidelines, iqRAMP, statistical analysis plans, informed consent documents, clinical review forms, data edit checks, data quality planning, and Regional Medical Monitor – Medical Oversight Plan as needed; ultimately oversees work of the Study Team. Contributes to CRO / vendor selection to ensure studies are conducted consistent with protocol requirements, clinical plan expectations and study timelines, including ensuring medical/technical requirements for data integrity (e.g. lab specifications). Approves selection of countries, clinical sites and investigators with appropriate qualifications, patient populations and recruitment strategy to meet study goals in a timely, high-quality and cost-effective manner. Ensures studies are registered on www.clinicaltrials.gov , study details are kept up to date and basic results are disclosed as required. Creates (and where appropriate, delivers) clinical/protocol training materials for study and site management, site initiation visits and investigator meetings. Helps establish and oversees Data Monitoring Committees (DMCs) and endpoint adjudication committees, including chartering, contracts, provision of relevant data and documentation of outcomes. Jointly accountable with the study team for study enrollment and adherence to agreed timelines for study deliverables. Maintains direct contact with investigative sites through site visits, telephone contacts and email to facilitate investigator engagement, address protocol or investigational product questions and support enrollment activities; works in conjunction with RCSLs when assigned. Consistent with the Safety Review Plan (SRP), performs and documents regular review of individual subject safety data and cumulative safety data with the safety risk lead; all safety review is performed in consultation with a medically qualified Medical Monitor. Identifies emerging safety trends and escalates for further discussion with the Clinical Program Lead and/or Global Clinical Lead; follows up with investigators for specific safety findings (e.g. SAEs). Reviews and manages protocol deviations. Works with the study team to ensure high quality of data during study conduct (e.g. appropriate patient population, adequacy of clinical assessments). Conducts clinical review and interpretation of efficacy and safety data, including delivery of top-line reports with statisticians and clinical study reports with medical writers; accountable for quality and timeliness of analysis and reporting. Responsible for the clinical and scientific validity of study reports, especially conclusions regarding efficacy and safety, and for appropriate disclosure of safety and efficacy data. Ensures narrative strategy for clinical trials is consistent with program narrative strategy; writes or oversees writing of safety narratives. Assists in ensuring regulatory compliance for clinical trials and reporting; contributes to primary publication of clinical trial results. Acts as primary contact with external investigators and internal study teams for clinical/medical protocol questions as needed. Keeps the Development China Clinical Program Lead and/or Category Development Lead informed of critical issues related to benefit-risk evaluation or study delivery (budget, timelines, quality). Presents to internal and external advisory committees on clinical trial design and data. Site Liaison Responsibilities Serves as clinical site liaison, supporting trial conduct through virtual meetings, teleconferences and face-to-face contact; maintains the “Face of Pfizer” at sites. Builds and maintains positive relationships with site staff and key stakeholders. Ensures site staff understand protocol requirements (technical and logistic); partners with site staff and study teams to overcome feasibility and operational barriers. Conducts frank discussions, sets clear expectations and monitors site performance through metrics. Identifies quality issues and escalates protocol-related issues to appropriate medical leads and operational issues to operations team members. Provides coaching, training and best-practice sharing to site staff. General Motivates and engages colleagues in understanding disease areas, indications and mechanisms of action. Coaches and mentors less experienced clinicians; may directly manage clinicians. Maintains and enhances knowledge in relevant disease and technical areas, practice guidelines and regional clinical trial requirements. Interfaces with other Pfizer sites, business units and functions to share best practices. Organizes expert panels, consultant or advisory board meetings as needed. Provides clinical support for Scientific and Commercialization Support (SCS), approved medicines, co-promotions, product defense and epidemiology / OR studies. Assists in development of publications, abstracts and presentations. Leads or supports preparation of clinical content for regulatory submissions (e.g. NDA, MAA, IND, sNDA, IB, AR). Supports discussions with regulators and resolution of regulatory or ethics committee queries. Ensures compliance with global and local training requirements and clinical/medical controlled documents (CMCDs). Contributes to continuous improvement activities and clinical staff training. Qualifications (Training, Education & Prior Experience) Education Required: M.D., Ph.D., D.V.M., M.S., and/or PharmD or equivalent qualifications. Preferred: Postgraduate training, certification or fellowship in a medical discipline or drug development is preferred. Demonstrated scientific productivity (e.g. doctoral thesis, publications, research reports). Experience Preferred: Thorough understanding of local and international regulations applicable to clinical trials (pre- and post-approval). Practical experience in clinical trial strategies, methods and processes. Track record of design, oversight and interpretation of clinical studies. Previous leadership or management experience or training. Required: Knowledge and experience in Good Clinical Practices (GCP). Experience in conduct and execution of clinical trials, including operational feasibility, recruitment, investigator performance and site relations. Ability to translate innovative approaches into action focused on trial execution and site performance. Partner with internal digital, and commercial teams to ensure the successful and timely delivery of engagement platforms, tools, and analytics that meet evolving business needs. Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in omnichannel engagement, digital marketing, and customer analytics, proposing innovative approaches for continuous improvement. Provide expert analysis, strategic recommendations, and data-driven insights to support leadership decision-making in customer engagement, digital innovation, and business model optimization. 职能类别: 薪资待遇：不显示职位月薪
学历要求: Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, Risk Management, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, data protection, privacy, regulatory compliance, risk management, or related disciplines, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or project leadership capacity. Strong knowledge of cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance frameworks,and applicable regulatory
岗位描述: ROLE SUMMARY Our Global Cybersecurity Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team provides comprehensive blueprints for cybersecurity excellence by embedding governance, risk management, and compliance into every layer. The team is responsible for ensuring risk-based decision-making is used and that security, privacy, and regulatory compliance is integrated seamlessly with Pfizer's organization. We are seeking a Manager, Information Protection & Technology Privacy, to lead and oversee the enterprise information protection program and serve as the primary Technology & Cyber Privacy Advisor within the Cyber GRC organization. This role ensures that sensitive data — across intellectual property, regulated data, and confidential business information — is appropriately classified, protected, and handled in alignment with Pfizer policies, regulatory expectations, and risk tolerance. This role partners closely with Data Protection Engineering, Privacy, Legal, IT, Security Operations, and the DPO office to operationalize controls, drive adoption of data protection standards, ensure ongoing compliance across a complex, regulated pharmaceutical environment, and support Business Units in navigating privacy obligations across multiple jurisdictions. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Act as a trusted advisor on cybersecurity, information protection, and data privacy matters across APAC and AMEA. Partner with Business, Digital & Technology, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders to provide pragmatic cybersecurity and information protection guidance for strategic initiatives, business transformations, and technology projects. Assess and manage cybersecurity and information protection risks associated with business initiatives, applications, digital solutions, and third-party engagements. Ensure compliance with applicable cybersecurity and data protection regulations across APAC and AMEA, including CSL, DSL, PIPL, GDPR, NIS2, and related regulatory requirements. Support regulatory inspections, audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory engagements as required. Lead cybersecurity and data protection compliance programs, including regulatory assessments, filings, remediation planning, and related compliance activities. Monitor emerging cybersecurity threats, regulatory developments, and compliance risks, and drive security awareness, risk management, and information protection initiatives across the organization. Support defining information protection controls for our organization to ensure regulatory compliance. Support in the development of data protection policies and standards. Support cybersecurity incident response, escalation, and remediation activities when required. This role requires flexibility to collaborate with stakeholders and support business needs across multiple time zones. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, Risk Management, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, data protection, privacy, regulatory compliance, risk management, or related disciplines, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or project leadership capacity. Strong knowledge of cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance frameworks,and applicable regulatory requirements. Strong understanding of cybersecurity and data protection regulations, including CSL, DSL, PIPL, GDPR, DPDPA, NIS2, and related requirements. Experience supporting cybersecurity assessments, audits, regulatory inspections, compliance programs, or risk management initiatives. Experience and hands on familiarity with DLP and data discovery tools, as well as data labeling and tagging solutions, including deployment and ongoing support. Working knowledge of data encryption concepts and approaches across different environments. Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technology functions in a global environment. Strong project coordination across business and technical teams. Professional proficiency in English. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, CIPP/E, CIPM, or equivalent are preferred. Experience supporting cybersecurity, information protection, data privacy, or regulatory compliance programs within the pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences industry is strongly preferred. Hands ‑ on experience with GRC platforms (e.g., Archer). Familiarity with privacy, intellectual property protection, and regulated data environments. The Team Member performs day‑to‑day operations, lifecycle, and support activities across cybersecurity and network domains ensuring resilient, secure, and optimized Digital and Automation systems. The role works closely with the Cyber Security & Network Lead, the global Cyber Security Team and cross‑functional partners to support secure infrastructure operations, incident response, and continuous improvement at site level. Support change management activities for infrastructure and cybersecurity changes, including impact assessments, documentation updates, and coordination with relevant stakeholders. Execute and improve software and hardware lifecycle delivery, (e.g. patching, upgrades, and end-of-life tasks) following approved plans and change management processes. Optimize OT & IT infrastructure and architecture execution and infrastructure monitoring practices. Contribute to improving crisis response and business continuity effectiveness. 岗位描述: Position Overview The Patient Product Manager is responsible for designing, developing, and managing patient-centric digital products powered by AI and emerging technologies that enhance patient experience, engagement, and health outcomes across Pfizer China's commercial portfolio. Reporting to the GTMx Solution Lead for Commercial AI Innovation, this role bridges the gap between commercial strategy, medical science, and digital product innovation — driving meaningful, compliant, and human-centered engagement with patients at scale. The incumbent will define and execute the patient product roadmap, lead cross-functional product delivery, and champion the patient perspective within Pfizer China's AI transformation agenda. Key Responsibilities Patient Product Strategy Define and execute the patient product roadmap aligned with Pfizer China's commercial priorities and AI innovation strategy, identifying high-impact opportunities to improve patient engagement, education, treatment adherence, and health outcomes through digital solutions. Develop compelling product business cases and strategic proposals that secure senior leadership endorsement and cross-functional resource commitment. Product Development Lifecycle Lead end-to-end product development from opportunity identification and concept design through build, pilot, launch, scale, and iteration — following agile product development principles and structured stage-gate governance. Define product vision, user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature prioritization frameworks, collaborating closely with digital engineering, UX design, medical, and commercial teams to deliver products that meet user needs and business objectives. Patient Insights & Research Conduct and synthesize patient journey research, voice-of-patient studies, ethnographic research, and competitive market analysis to develop deep understanding of patient needs, pain points, information gaps, and behavioral drivers. Translate patient insights into actionable product requirements and design principles, ensuring every product decision is anchored in real-world patient experience and validated with target users. AI-Powered Product Innovation Leverage artificial intelligence, machine learning, personalization engines, conversational AI (chatbots/virtual health assistants), and generative AI technologies to create differentiated, scalable, and adaptive patient engagement solutions. Monitor and evaluate emerging AI technologies and digital health innovations for applicability to patient product development, proposing pilot initiatives to explore and validate new approaches. Cross-functional Collaboration Partner with brand/marketing teams, medical affairs, regulatory/legal, compliance, IT, patient advocacy, and external technology vendors and agencies to ensure products are scientifically sound, commercially impactful, and fully compliant. Serve as the patient product lead within cross-functional squads, facilitating alignment on scope, timelines, dependencies, and risk management across all stakeholder groups. Product Performance Management Define product KPIs, usage metrics, outcome measures, and patient satisfaction indicators; build analytics dashboards and reporting frameworks to enable ongoing performance monitoring and data-driven product decisions. Establish structured feedback loops — including user testing, patient advisory panels, and real-world evidence review — to continuously improve product features, usability, and health impact. Market Landscape & Competitive Intelligence Monitor patient digital product trends, competitive offerings, technology developments, and regulatory changes in pharmaceutical patient engagement; identify whitespace opportunities for product differentiation and innovation. Build and maintain an external intelligence network spanning technology partners, patient communities, academic institutions, and healthcare ecosystem players to inform product strategy. Regulatory & Compliance Ensure all patient products comply with NMPA regulations, Pfizer's global product development standards, data privacy requirements (PIPL/GDPR principles), and applicable pharmaceutical promotional guidelines throughout the productlifecycle. Engage proactively with legal, compliance, and medical review processes, building compliant-by-design products that maintain the highest standards of patient safety and data protection. Stakeholder Communication Present product strategies, roadmap updates, performance results, and business case recommendations to senior leadership and cross-functional governance forums; champion the patient perspective in all commercial decision-making. Develop and maintain clear internal product documentation (product briefs, roadmap decks, feature specs) that enables efficient cross-functional alignment and handoff. Qualifications Bachelor's degree or above in Business, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Digital Health, Human-Computer Interaction, Health Informatics, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in product management, digital health product development, or commercial strategy roles within pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare technology sectors. Proven track record in developing and launching digital products or patient engagement programs — from concept through live product — with hands-on experience in product design, user research, agile development, and product analytics. Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical patient journey, chronic disease management, treatment adherence, and the regulatory landscape for patient-facing digital health products in China. Familiarity with AI/ML tools, digital health platforms, CRM systems, patient engagement technologies, and remote patient monitoring solutions; direct experience with generative AI product applications is a significant plus. Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven approach to product prioritization and decision-making; experience with product analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude) and A/B testing methodologies. Strong project management skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent product workstreams, competing priorities, and diverse stakeholder groups. Exceptional communication and influencing skills; ability to translate complex scientific and technical content into clear, patient-friendly messaging and compelling executive presentations. Patient-first mindset combined with commercial acumen; demonstrated passion for improving patient health outcomes and healthcare system innovation. Fluency in both English and Mandarin (written and spoken) required. We are dedicated to advancing healthcare solutions that deliver life-changing outcomes. Looking ahead, our vision is to expand our footprint in internal medicines, with a particular focus on weight management, diabetes, and cardiovascular diseases in the coming years. We are strategically broadening our portfolio to address a wider range of chronic conditions. The recent acquisition of Metsera is a testament to our forward-thinking approach, further reinforcing our dedication to innovation and our commitment to addressing unmet patient needs within the metabolism space. 职能类别: 薪资待遇：不显示职位月薪
学历要求: ● Bachelor's Degree is required, Master degree or MBA is preferred
岗位描述: Why Patients Need You Pfizer's marketing and market research teams position our product portfolio to meet the needs of patients and health care providers. Whether you are involved in marketing, planning, forecasting, or implementation, your contribution will be important to understanding patients’ needs and the market insights so that we can create value that changes patients’ lives. What You Will Achieve You will be in an important and exciting role of providing marketing direction for Pfizer’s wide array of products. Your coordination skills will be helpful in managing the marketing plan and launching programs to create demand for product lines. You will evaluate brand performance periodically and recommend product development or enhancement as well as oversee development of marketing material. Your leadership skills will be useful to provide direction to the sales force for activities, such as advertising, public relations and product strategy implementation to achieve product marketing objectives. As a Manager, you provide guidance to operational teams for managing projects. Your planning skills will help in preparing forecasts for resource requirements, and providing areas of improvement for products, processes or services. Through your comprehensive knowledge of principles, concepts and theories of the discipline, you will also work towards advancing new concepts and methodologies. You will be able to take a leadership role to facilitate agreements between different teams. It is your hard work and focus that will make Pfizer ready to achieve new milestones and help patients across the globe. How You Will Achieve It ● Provide guidance, lead/co-lead projects, manage own time to meet objectives and plan resource requirements for projects across the division. ● Lead the development of the business plan for the in-market and pipeline products. ● Manage strategy development and execution to maximize revenues. ● Develop awareness campaigns, congress content in partnership with the Medical team. ● Develop channel specific customer segmentation and go-to-market models, Life-cycle Management plan for Brand or Portfolio. ● Select best fitting modules for local needs for campaign development. ● Manage cross-functional brand leadership across Field Force, Account management, medical, legal, regulatory, etc. ● Lead in-country cross-functional team and work in collaboration with global cross-functional teams in order to coordinate the activities of these teams to achieve brand objectives. ● Forecast brand performance and track progress towards target. ● Manage local agencies for trans-creation and validate brand-specific messages, design training. ● Ensure that customer and patient insights as well as market issues are well understood and processed into the local and European business plans. ● Drive market intelligence gathering initiatives for existing and new products by liaising with the sales teams and market research agencies. Qualifications ● Bachelor's Degree is required, Master degree or MBA is preferred； ● Innovation ability in Programs； ● Clinical Medicine/Pharmacy/Biology/Chemistry/Pharmaceutical manicuring related majors is preferred; ● At least 5 years working experience in Pharmaceutical industry； ● Experience of managing revenues and costs is required; ● Knowledge of Marketing Mix principles, business acumen and marketing execution is must have; ● Preferred demonstrated initiative, strong strategic and leadership skills; ● Track record of working collaboratively across functions; ● Product management experience; ● Fluent in written and spoken English is required; ● Advanced Microsoft Office capabilities, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word is must have. Work Location Assignment: On Premise Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. 岗位描述: 职责概述 医学信息沟通地区经理负责管理所辖区域的一切业务，包括制订和实施区域的工作目标和发展计划，建立一个绩效良好、极富生产力和士气高昂的团队。对客户的需求做出适当反应以实现区域的各项工作 目标。对医学信息沟通专员的行为进行规范和监管，对他们的专业技能提升和学习发展规划提供辅导和支 持。 主要工作和任务 1. 制订并执行所辖区域的业务计划，推动团队实现公司和上级经理下达的各项工作目标和任 务。 2. 招聘符合公司基本要求的人员（包括各种雇佣形式和编制），定期对团队成员进行绩效和行为的评估，实施奖惩或激励措施。 3. 制订并执行培养团队成员合规意识的计划，规范其工作行为，确保各项活动的真实性和合规性。 4. 制订并执行提升团队成员的专业知识和技能的计划，并对其个人发展规划提供指导与支持。 5. 通过有计划的随访，在与专员讨论区域业务及市场活动时对其进行针对性的辅导。 6. 监控和分析市场发展趋势，挖掘区域市场机会，为公司策略的制订提供反馈和建议。 7. 协调并有效地实施各个项目及活动，合理分配和控制各项资源。有效管理项目和活动的流程，确保其真实有效地开展。 8. 与区域内关键客户保持持续的沟通，建立并持续优化合作伙伴关系。 9. 熟悉对当前及未来业务有影响的政策，必要情况下可根据公司的要求，与相关职能部门合作，参与或协调所辖区域的市场准入工作。 10. 建立和保持有效沟通系统，包括定期召开地区会议，定期与上级经理汇报区域工作进展，与其他部门建立协作关系。 11. 为制订和修改业务相关的政策和流程及其他内部政策提供建议，以实现高效率的业务运作。 12. 支持公司的各项创新举措，带领团队成员执行新举措，并且主动探索创新的机会和方法。 13. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 · 教育： - 大学专科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 · 技能： - 熟练使用 MS Office ，英语良好。 - 具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。 - 具备较强的影响力和策略性思维能力。 - 具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。 - 具备较强的团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 经验： - 至少 3 年制药行业同等公司的医药代表工作经验，具备符合合规要求的优秀的绩效记录 , 具备管理 潜力。 - 有制药行业业务管理经验者优先。 · 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但 不限于 FCPA ( 《反海外腐败法》 ) 及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真 实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 · 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合现行合规调查流程，处分等级 & 时限等的要求。 - 至少有 2 年以上辉瑞医药代表工作经验；萌芽优先。 - 过去两年的绩效， 需达到或超过团队平均水平。 核心能力 专业合规 : 打造专业团队 – 评估专员的专业知识和技能的掌握和应用情况，利用各种方式提升团队成员的专业知识和技 能。 打造合规团队 – 理解合规各项规定的意义和原则， 培养团队成员的合规意识，规范团队成员的合规行为，防 范合规风险。 业务决断 : 有效规划业务 – 制定业务计划时既紧密结合大区策略，又把握地区特点和规律。系统分析市场 – 通过对区域市场，客户和政策信息的综合分析形成市场洞察。 客户融动 : 优化伙伴关系 – 深入理解并引导客户需求，建立并优化合作伙伴关系。 推动合作共赢 – 理解合作部门的工作目标和重点，当需要时能整合公司资源，推动内部合作。 组织发展 : 激发团队士气 – 明确团队管理规则，激发团队士气和凝聚力。 辅导发展他人 – 关注员工的发展， 通过辅导和支持来提升员工的能力。 自主执行 : 推动团队达成 – 准确制定团队工作计划，通过监督和跟进推动团队实现目标。 勇于承担责任 – 为团队的绩效结果负责，为实现公司的目标愿意承担起额外责任。 自我发展 : 自主规划发展 – 洞察自身优势和不足，制定并执行个人发展计划以促进持续学习，主动寻找并利用提升自身 能力的机会和资源。 创新变革 : 积极探索创新 – 正确理解并引导团队积极面对各种变化，积极探索工作中的创新机会。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. Assists with ensuring initial and continuous training programs are implemented and maintained for all relevant PCO colleagues. Ensures planned, permanent & temporary changes of GMP/GDP related activities & systems are managed & documented appropriately. Ensures change actions are completed as per agreed timelines. Collects key quality performance indicators, evaluates and highlights any significant trends and identifies actions. Monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) of the QMS, evaluate and highlight significant trends, and identify actions. Leads and/or participates in Quality Review Meetings as required. Provides support in the preparation and coordination of any Health Authority (HA) inspection and/or internal Pfizer audits of GMP/GDP activities in the PCO. Work with local cross functional team to define appropriate action plans to address the inspection/audit observation and tracks action implementation within the agreed timelines. Participates in the self-inspection program as an auditor and/or auditee, as required. Leads and/or participates in the Quality Risk Management program for the consistent application, documentation and communication of risks to product quality/patient safety in support of GxP activities under the remit of SOQ. 2、Local Product Disposition & Resolution of Product Quality Perform the local release process of Products under the PCOs distribution license, as required. Supports the coordination of all Product repackaging and/or relabeling activities in the PCO and at the third-party packaging site. Review and approve documentation related to the repackaging and/or relabeling of Pfizer Product, as required. Actions Quarantine Alert Notifications promptly, as needed. Ensures quarantine shipments are managed compliantly according to procedures, as required. Provides support for any market action operation in the PCO, as required. Complaint Handling – Perform Intake and Triage, issue correspondence letter as required. Acts as a contact point for Regulatory Agency/reporter in the PCO, as required. Lead and/or participate in deviation investigations using appropriate tools and works with cross-functional teams to implement CAPAs. Notify Management of significant concerns or deviations within the QMS which have the potential to impact product, regardless of release status. Where issues originate in the PCO, assist with the preparation of QRT meetings, where required. Assist with the implementation of local actions identified during QRT. Management of relevant corrective and preventative actions (CAPA) 3、Supplier Quality Management Execute tasks associated with the management of GxP Suppliers including qualification, quality oversight in accordance with internal and regulatory requirements for GxP activities. Assists with ensuring appropriate customer screening processes are in place to align with Pfizer and local regulations, as required. Assist with the coordination of RQA audits at the Supplier. 4、Leadership Skills Facilitate development and execution of objectives / projects consistent with SOQ Purpose Blueprint. Development and Maintenance of Quality culture, within the team and organization. 5、Local Requirements Responsible for operation under GSP license. Responsible for IDC importation testing/surveillance testing. Responsible for Annual Product Report/Annual Product Quality Review Report completion as needed for regulation requirements. Support other required from local regulations. Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements) A minimum Tertiary Education in Science, Pharmacy or related discipline. A minimum of 5 years in the pharmaceutical industry in a quality role Demonstrated ability to influence, when necessary, particularly with stakeholders and external parties. Experience in GSP and QMS. Technical writing and reporting Licensed Pharmacist is preferred Fluent in English (written & verbal) Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements) Experience in quality administered systems Strong organizational skills and attention to detail Experience with regulatory compliance and documentation Ability to mentor and review the work of other colleagues Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving and enhance productivity.
